Fun Facts[]

  • The Full Name of "Anne Park" is "Good Queen Anne Memorial Park".
  • As per the request of the Developer, this station is built in an "Ordinary Manner". As a result, this station alludes to Stations from late Season 1, at the time when West Ring Line completed development. Coincidentally, West Ring Line also completed development at around the Halozy vicinity in Twenty-Second Continent.[2]
  • The Blocks of gold are used in this station to allude to Queen Anne.[3]
  • The tracks of Masquerade Line passes between the Ground Level and the Concourse of this Station.

History[]

  • January 30 2021: This station began services.[4]
  • February 18 2024: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • April 23 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.

Anshield Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It features a Nazca Railway Station featuring Stadium Line. It is developed en masse with Searabbit Island and is linked by the Seashield Bridge.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2  Transport
    • 2.1 Railways
    • 2.2 Anshield Island Light Rail
    • 2.3 Ferry 
    • 2.4 External Access
  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

Anshield Island is located in the center of West Metropolis Archipelago. It is named after the fact that this island looks like a broken shield.

 Transport[]

Railways[]

  • Nazca Railway Stadium Line Anshield Island Station

Anshield Island Light Rail[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Anshield Island Light Rail.

Major Accidents[]

  • March 2 2020: This station has been sabotaged due to historical reasons,[2][3] and requires reconstruction.[4] Services of Stadium Line between Middle Island Station and Bulldoze Island Station has been suspended as a result.

History[]

  • June 27 2015: This station began services.
  • May 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[5]
  • January 17 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • August 28 2019: Exit C is added to this station.[7]
  • March 2 2020: The structure of this station has been sabotaged.[8]At the same day, the station structure has been recovered.[9]
  • November 21 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[10]
  • May 23 2023: This station completed exit naming.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Central Track of this station allows trains to return to Vector Bay Depot.
  • The Chinese Name of this station alludes to East Tsim Sha Tsui Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.
  • This station was originally named "Tip East Station". However, to commemorate the Railway Builder starting to play Apex Legends, this station is renamed "Apex East Station" as the Chinese name of Apex Legends also happens to allude to the Chinese name of Apex Station.

History[]

  • November 12 2016: This station began services.
  • April 21 2021: This station is renamed "Apex East Station" to allude to the game "Apex Legends". This has caused this station and Apex Station to become the second batch of stations that are renamed after construction since Fansim Island Station.[3]

Apex Station is a station on East Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Oasis.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was originally named "Vertex Tip Station". However, to commemorate the Railway Builder starting to play Apex Legends, this station is renamed "Apex Station" as the Chinese name of Apex Legends also happens to allude to the Chinese name of this station.

History[]

  • November 10 2016: This station began services.
  • April 21 2021: This station is renamed "Apex Station" to allude to the game "Apex Legends". This has caused this station and Apex East Station to become the second batch of stations that are renamed after construction since Fansim Island Station.[3]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Targeted Excellence.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Targeted Excellence 03:36
Still Between the Strings 04:11

Fun Facts[]

  • In order to correspond to the Chinese Name of this station, which in turn corresponds to the nearby Gungding Tsuen settlement, 30m shooting ranges are seen at the east end of the concoures of this station. A 20m shooting range and a 40m shooting range would also be seen at Bowplate River Station.
  • When this station was constructed, the Station Number of Sparkling Line was 12-02. However, due to the construction of Enning Station and to reserve room for future Centopia development, the Station Number is now 12-03. The original Station Number of this station has since been used by Relish North Station.[3]

History[]

  • July 31 2019: This Station began services. Sparkling Line is established.
  • November 7 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]
  • December 31 2022: Due to the construction of Enning Station and future Centopia development, the Station Number of Sparkling Line has changed.[5]
  • November 9 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Fun Facts[]

  • Prior to the start of S3E14P1, a low-resolution Route Map for S3E14P1 was released on Discord. However, due to the low resolution, multiple players have misread the Station name as "Cool Hill Station". While the high-resolution route map was subsequently released, the misnomer still nonetheless became a meme prior to the renaming of this station.
  • The Original Name of this Station (Sandviched Hill Station) alludes to the Sandvich Edible Device in Team Fortress 2,[4] as well as a series of Stations in Nazca Railway Terracept Division that begins with the word Sandviched, such as Sandviched Sand Station and Sandviched Snow Station.[5] However, the name of this station has since changed to Apple Hill Station.
  • While this station originally planned to use green as the color scheme of this station, as Apple Daily, a former Hong Kong-based newspaper, closed down at the time of this station's construction, the color scheme of that newspaper is used at that station instead.[6]
  • To Pay tribute to Apple Daily, a Station Art resembling the icon of Apple Daily is also built above the Concourse of this Station at the North Wing with NR Shops, and the name of this station is also renamed to Apple Hill Station at the beginning of S3E15 for the same reason.

History[]

  • June 25 2021: This Station began construction.
  • June 28 2021: This Station copmleted construction.
  • June 29 2021: This Station began services alongside Stadium Line.
  • November 23 2021: This Station is renamed Apple Hill Station.[7]

Description []

Aquilo Circuit is one of the District lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs within the Intus Aquilo District but does not go into Intus Aquilo Island.

This route is represented by Green on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 40.

Currently, this route is 10.265 km long, with a total of 8 stations.

Arcgo Line is Line Number 6 of NR Los Sengas Division Standard Railway. This line mainly serves the north side of Downtown. With 31 stations along the line, this line was established on May 1 2015, and runs between Fall Point and Cooace Hill.

Description []

Arcgo Line is one of the Core Lines in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and runs to the north of Downtown. The line starts from Peckern North, and passes through West Metropolis Archipelago, the Threeler area of Sava, before reaching Downtown. Afterwards, it passes through Katadelphia, Flask, Youngsters and Glacier, before reaching Ingress. Future development will see it extending to Winsol and Asylum.

This route is represented by Dark Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 6.

Currently, this route is 49.62 km long, with a total of 31 stations.

Line Charcteristics[]

  • One of the six initially planned lines of NR Los Sengas Division.
  • "Arcgo" is the abbreviation of "Archipelago".
  • Mainly serves areas to the north of Downtown.
  • Has an emergency stop at Ponsand Island.
  • Except for North Coast Road Station, all stations along this line uses Platform Screen Doors.
  • This line adopts a fully enclosed design, including in overground sections.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Alpha Line (East): Metropolis to Katadelphia North
    • Delta Line (West): Metropolis to Jayler

Fun Facts[]

  • Despite being named Arcgo Line, this line is the last Core Line to reach West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA) in Season 1. [2]
  • Initial plans of Nazca Railway through the WMA features Ponsand, Ponrest, Belt Island, Elevate Island and Inthree Island before reaching Eagle Island, which is part of the existing route. However, Nazca Ferry (NFC) opposed to this proposal due to conflicts in shipping routes. As a result, Nazca Railway reduced the number of islands stopped by this line, and the section between Ponsand and Elevate Island was diverted to Star Island to gain approval from NFC.
  • Belt Island Station was one of the planned stations of this line, but was rejected by NFC. This station instead served Delta Line in 2016. [3]
  • Elevate Island Station was one of the planned stations of this line, but was rejected by NFC. This station instead served Interisland Line in 2017.
  • Ponrest Station was one of the planned stations of this line, but was rejected by NFC. This station instead served Stadow Line in 2019.
  • Ponsand Island featured a set of emergency platforms, but trains do not stop there. (Originally, plans were set to have a station there, but due to development from NFC, this plan was aborted.)
  • Originally, Mayler Airport Station was built between Jayler Station and Mayler Station, but due to privatisation of Mayler Airport, that station was never put in use and was later demolished when Delta Line was established.
  • Origin Station was originally meant to be built after S1E4, but due to the fact that this section shares tracks wtih Stadium Line, this line was prematurely established, and before the establishment of Origin Line, a set of hollow walls was built behind the side platforms of this line to hide the reserved space for that line. Once Origin Line is established, the walls are demolished and the side platforms become island platforms.
  • A set of sidings is placed between Fosina Station and High Parallel Station.
  • Since the establishment of this line, all stations and sections involved are enclosed even when they are elevated. As a result, some players refer to this phenomenon, as well as the Railway founder, as "The Enclosed Curse of Arcgo Line".
  • Will extend to Rover Line Fairlight Station and Glacier Line Arctic Sea Station in the future.

Arcgo North Island Station is a station on Stadow Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Arcgo North Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Peckern Transit Northland Line (Arcgo North Island Station) and Arcgo North Island Light Rail (East Coast Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the second last station to be built at West Metropolis Archipelago, with the last station being Midway Island Node.[2]
  • To commemorate the above, this station uses a glass structure at the ceilings of the platform, and a dome is also placed at the south end of the platforms for sea views.
  • This Station has the longest English Station Name behind Katadelphia City Center Node at 16 letters. As a result, the name of this station could not be fitted into a single column.[3]

History[]

  • April 18 2020: This Station began services.
  • August 27 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]

Arcgo West Island is an artificial island located outside the east coast of Peckern North. While Arcgo West Isle originally belonged to West Metropolis Archipelago, repeated island reclamation has caused development on this island, as well as the Arcgo West Isle, to be connected to Peckern North. Hence, both the island and the isle now belongs to Peckern North.

Contents

  • 1 Transport
    • 1.1 Railway
    • 1.2 Roads
    • 1.3 Buses/Public Transit
  • 2 Points of Interest
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Citations and References

Transport[]

Railway[]

Interisland Line and Glinstrouß Line passes through this island, and Arcgo West Island Station is set up in here.

Roads[]

  • Arcgo West Island Road
  • Arcgo West Isle Road
  • Crosswater Street／Interisland Street

Buses/Public Transit[]

A small-scaled bus terminus is located at the west of this island, and is served by the following bus routes:

  • CTB R702 to En-Cogn

Points of Interest[]

  • Arcgo West Island Sports Ground
  • Arcgo West Island Swimming Pool
  • Arcgo West Isle Centre: The only building located at the non-reclamation area (Arcgo West Isle)
  • Interverde: A commercial-residential project

Fun Facts[]

  • This island is NOT a part of West Metropolis Archipelago, and is an artifical island.[1]
  • Arcgo West Isle was formerly the Westernmost Point of West Metropolis Archipelago. However, after the northward extension of West Metropolis Archipelago and this island was drawn into Peckern North, the Westernmost point is now located on a yet unnamed island.
  • Arcgo West Isle was developed by Teleturtles until he was banned from Project Nazca.
  • Except for Arcgo West Isle, almost the entirety of Arcgo West Island was reclaimed.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station replaced Finnick Station as the permanent Up Direction Terminus of Interisland Line.
  • The design of this station alludes to Newmonth River Station in the regards that stairs are in place for passengers to access the platform at the opposite side and on different floors.[2]
  • This Station is built in order to facilitate access out of the West Metropolis Archipelago for Interisland Line from the north. This way, once Glinstrouß Line reaches here, Passengers can have a more direct access to Peckern North and Peckern without taking detours to the south.
  • The Concourse and Platforms of this station are of even width in order to facilitiate the widths of the stairs to the concourse.[3]

History[]

  • April 14 2022: This station began construction.
  • April 15 2022: This station completed construction.[4]
